"System fault during operation: Running Total Generates Identical Duplicate Numbers on Duplicate Dates".
What is the verified root cause?

options.text: Window frame specification uses default RANGE frame instead of ROWS frame, causing rows with identical ORDER BY keys to sum together simultaneously.

explanation:
Root Cause: Window frame specification uses default RANGE frame instead of ROWS frame, causing rows with identical ORDER BY keys to sum together simultaneously.

Fix Resolution:
